## Verdict

**Kelp** costs least for a team of 8, at **$168 per month**, despite having the highest per-seat rate on the list. Its 1-seat minimum means the team pays for exactly 8 seats. Acme Desk and Fennel HQ both carry minimums well above 8, so their lower headline rates are irrelevant at this size: Acme Desk bills for 20 seats ($220) and Fennel HQ for 40 ($600).

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Acme Desk | $11 | 20 |
| Fennel HQ | $15 | 40 |
| Kelp | $21 | 1 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for = the greater of 8 (team size) or the vendor minimum.

- **Kelp:** minimum 1 < 8, so 8 seats paid. 8 × $21 = **$168 per month**. Effective rate $21.00 per person.
- **Acme Desk:** minimum 20 > 8, so 20 seats paid. 20 × $11 = **$220 per month**. Twelve unused seats, worth $132. Effective rate $27.50 per person ($220 ÷ 8).
- **Fennel HQ:** minimum 40 > 8, so 40 seats paid. 40 × $15 = **$600 per month**. Thirty-two unused seats, worth $480. Effective rate $75.00 per person ($600 ÷ 8).

Kelp is $52 per month cheaper than Acme Desk and $432 per month cheaper than Fennel HQ — $624 and $5,184 per year.

## Risks

**This ranking is fragile and reverses with modest growth.** Kelp wins only because of the minimums, not because it is cheap per seat. Acme Desk's $220 is fixed until headcount reaches 20; Kelp passes $220 at 11 seats (11 × $21 = $231). So a team of 11 or more is better off on Acme Desk, and the advantage widens from there. Fennel HQ overtakes Kelp at 29 seats (29 × $21 = $609 versus a flat $600). If the team is expected to grow past 10 in the contract term, re-run these figures before committing.

**Price only.** The list gives per-seat rates and seat minimums and nothing else. Features, support tiers, usage limits, security posture and integrations are unknown, so this says which vendor is cheaper at 8 seats, not which is the better buy.

**Billing terms.** All figures assume list price billed monthly, as stated. Annual commitments, volume discounts, onboarding fees and overage charges are not on the price list and could change the ranking. Confirm also whether minimums are enforced only at signup or persist through the term if headcount drops.
